'''Baltanos''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''The Divine Apparatus''' in the '''Deriso''' system of the [[Colonia]] region. He specialises in suit mobility and endurance alongside weapon handling, accuracy, and sound suppression.<ref name="inara-baltanos">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/35/ Baltanos — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-baltanos">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Baltanos Baltanos], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

Frontier introduced Baltanos with the four Colonia Odyssey Engineers and identifies them as providers of suit and personal-equipment modifications for commanders working on low-atmosphere worlds.<ref name="frontier-colonia">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/galnet/the-view-from-colonia The View from Colonia], Frontier Developments, 29 October 2021. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

Baltanos's workshop is at '''The Divine Apparatus''', a surface Engineer base on '''Deriso 3 a''' in the '''Deriso''' system. The body is approximately 2,420 light-seconds from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-divine">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/427416/ The Divine Apparatus — Station], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

The workshop is in the Colonia region, roughly 22,000 light-years from Sol. No system permit is required.

== Discovery and access ==

=== Discovery ===

Baltanos is common knowledge and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-baltanos" />

=== Workshop unlock ===

Reach '''Friendly''' reputation with the '''Colonia Council'''.<ref name="inara-baltanos" />

Station services may not appear immediately after the unlock completes. If necessary, return to the main menu and re-enter the game.<ref name="inara-baltanos" />

== Services ==

Baltanos installs four suit modifications and three handheld-weapon modifications.<ref name="inara-baltanos" />

=== Suit modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Combat Movement Speed
| Removes the normal movement-speed penalty while aiming down sights.
|-
| Improved Jump Assist
| Extends the duration of the suit's Jump Assist thrust.
|-
| Increased Air Reserves
| Extends life-support operation after suit power is depleted.
|-
| Increased Sprint Duration
| Reduces exhaustion during sustained sprinting.
|}

=== Weapon modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Faster Handling
| Improves weapon draw, stow, and handling speed.
|-
| Improved Hip Fire Accuracy
| Improves accuracy when firing without aiming down sights.
|-
| Noise Suppressor
| Reduces weapon sound in pressurised environments.
|}

Suit and handheld-weapon modifications are permanent once installed. The equipment must have an unused modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits are paid at the workshop. See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for equipment grades, modification slots, material handling, and the installation process.

== Reputation and referrals ==

Odyssey Engineers do not use the Grade 1–5 workshop-reputation system used by ship Engineers. Once Baltanos is unlocked, his available modifications can be installed immediately when the equipment and material requirements are met.

Providing Baltanos with '''10 Faction Associates''' Data completes his direct referral requirement toward [[Yi Shen]].<ref name="inara-baltanos" /> Yi Shen becomes available only after the separate referral requirements from Baltanos, [[Eleanor Bresa]], and [[Rosa Dayette]] have all been completed.
